Houndoom

Dark Fire

Johto · Generation 2

Houndoom is a Dark/Fire-type Dark Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 35 kg. It evolves from Houndour. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (110), with a base stat total of 500.
